about.description: Subunit is a Base-native tokenized real estate platform offering fractional ownership of residential and commercial US properties to accredited investors. Each property is held in a Delaware Statutory Trust (DST) structure with on-chain token holders receiving rental distributions in stablecoin. Properties target single-family-rental and small multi-family markets. Subunit differentiates from RealT by using a single platform-level governance token (rather than separate REIT-style structures per property) and by targeting accredited investors only.
about.registryInfo: Subunit Labs Inc. is the platform operator. Property-specific tokens are issued through a Delaware Statutory Trust structure with each property held in its own DST. Tokens deployed on Base for low transaction cost. Backed by Coinbase Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, and others. SEC-Reg D 506(c) accredited-investor-only.

fees.revenueNotes: Real-estate platforms typically charge 1-2% AUM-equivalent fee for property management, plus mint/redemption costs at the DST level. Specific fee schedule per property.
